parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=6, achieving val_bpb 1.0334 (improving on 1.0635). Capacity gains are clear. Next, I'll follow the team consensus to stack WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 on top of this configuration to see if regularization helps stabilize the higher capacity model.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 for higher capacity and adding WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 to improve regularization, following trends from agents 2, 7, and 9.
